menu_options.usb: USB cable (panel micro-USB into this Home Assistant)

reconfigure.title: Change how the panel is connected

usb.title: USB connection
usb.description: Plug a data micro-USB cable from the panel into this Home Assistant machine (the panel shows up as an STM32 Virtual ComPort), or select a TTL-USB adaptor wired to a COM port set to W-RKP/UDL.

data_description.baud: USB (STM32 Virtual ComPort) ignores this — leave at 115200. For a TTL adaptor on a physical COM port set to W-RKP/UDL, if no data appears try the other rates.

network.title: Network connection
network.description: Use the IP address and port shown on the keypad under Ethernet.

bridge.title: Serial bridge
bridge.description: A device that relays a panel COM port (set to W-RKP/UDL mode) over TCP.

error.cannot_connect: No reply from the panel. Check the cable, port, IP address or bridge settings.
error.invalid_code: The code must be digits only.

abort.already_configured: This panel is already set up.
abort.wrong_panel: That address belongs to a different panel.

send_key.name: Send keypad key
send_key.description: Press one or more keys on the panel's virtual keypad.

config_entry_id.name: Panel
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one panel.

key.name: Key
key.description: One key, e.g. back, enter, up, 5.

keys.name: Keys
keys.description: A list of keys pressed in order.

omit_zone.name: Omit zone
omit_zone.description: Omit or reinstate zones, as the app's Omit button. Only zones the panel allows the user to omit.

omit.name: Omit
omit.description: On to omit, off to reinstate. Leave out to toggle.

code.name: PIN
code.description: Optional panel user code: the omit is done (and logged) as that user.

read_raw.name: Read raw (diagnostic)
read_raw.description: Read-only: send query reads [id, start, count] and return the raw reply blocks.

config_entry_id.name: Panel
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one panel.

get_events.name: Get event log
get_events.description: Read the panel's event log (1 = newest), as the app's Log page.

config_entry_id.name: Panel
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one panel.

test_user_login.name: Test user login
test_user_login.description: Diagnostic: log in with another panel user's code, then straight back in with the integration's own code. Never arms or disarms.

config_entry_id.name: Panel
config_entry_id.description: Which panel (only needed with more than one).

code.name: User code
code.description: The other user's code. Not stored or logged.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Reset an area after an alarm or tamper, as the Reset button, optionally as the panel user with the PIN given.

entity_id.name: Area
entity_id.description: The area's Reset button or alarm panel entity.

code.name: PIN
code.description: Optional panel user code: the reset is done (and logged) as that user.

get_notify_settings.name: Get alarm notification settings
get_notify_settings.description: A user's alarm notification settings, their phones, and the panel's areas and zones.

config_entry_id.name: Panel
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one panel.

user_id.name: HA user
user_id.description: Whose settings (admins only for other users). Default: you.

set_notify_settings.name: Set alarm notification settings
set_notify_settings.description: Choose which panel events a user is notified about, as the official app's per-phone settings.

config_entry_id.name: Panel
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one panel.

user_id.name: HA user
user_id.description: Whose settings (admins only for other users). Default: you.

categories.name: Categories
categories.description: Kinds of event: priority, alarms, tampers, faults, arming, test, restore, custom, chains, zones.

areas.name: Areas
areas.description: Area numbers to notify about (empty = all).

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Zone numbers that notify when they go active (with the Zones category).

devices.name: Phones
devices.description: Companion-app devices (config entry ids) to send to (empty = all the user's phones).

critical.name: Critical alerts
critical.description: Send Priority and Alarms as critical alerts that sound through silent / Do Not Disturb.

url.name: Open on tap
url.description: Dashboard path to open when the notification is tapped.

set_clock.name: Set panel clock
set_clock.description: Set the panel's time and date to Home Assistant's local time (or to the date and time given).

config_entry_id.name: Panel
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one panel.

datetime.name: Date and time
datetime.description: Leave empty to use Home Assistant's current local time.

data.clock_sync: Keep the panel clock in sync with Home Assistant

data_description.poll_interval: How often to ask the panel for status. 2 is responsive; higher is gentler on the CM2.
data_description.clock_sync: Sets the panel's time and date to HA's when it drifts, at most once an hour, never while an area is setting, in entry or in alarm. Turn off the panel's own "sync clock from cloud" so the two don't compete.
data_description.clock_tolerance: Sync when the panel is this many seconds ahead of or behind HA.
